questions.stem: A year on a certain planet is \\(3600\\) days. How many whole weeks are in a year if a week is (a) \\(6\\) days, (b) \\(8\\) days, (c) \\(10\\) days? (d) For each of those week lengths, how many weeks fit into a \\(150\\)-day month?
questions.hint: Divide the number of days by the length of a week each time.

steps.explain: Each part divides a number of days by the length of one week.
Parts (a) to (c): divide the \\(3600\\)-day year by each week length.
Part (d): divide the \\(150\\)-day month by the same three week lengths.
Note that \\(150\\) is not a multiple of \\(8\\), so an \\(8\\)-day week does not fit a whole number of times into the month.
